atoms.text: The first thing to do when doing research on the internet is to think about suitable keywords to type into the search engine.
atoms.sound: The first thing to do when doing reasearch on the internet is to think about suitable keywords to type into the search engine.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>suitable</voice> bedeutet passend <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>search engine</voice> bedeutet Suchmaschine

instruction.text: Beantworte die Fragen. Mehrere Antworten können richtig sein.

atoms.a: You want to do research on political debates in Canada. Which of the keywords would be most suitable?
atoms.sound: You want to do ree search on political debates in Canada. Which of the keywords would be most suitable?

atoms.a: The search has about 195,000,000 results. What can you do to specify your search?
b: ++add the year of the debate you want to do research on
++add a person that you want to know more about
add a random fact to the search bar

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>to specify</voice> bedeutet präzisieren oder spezifizieren

atoms.a: Sometimes, the search engine provides useful recommendations. Which ones could you use to further specify your search?
What is important when typing the keywords into the search engine?

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>capitalization</voice> bedeutet Großschreibung <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>spelling</voice> bedeutet Rechtschreibung

feedback.wrong: Bei einer Suchanfrage ist am wichtigsten, dass die Schlagwörter korrekt geschrieben sind. Groß- und Kleinschreibung ist weniger wichtig für den Suchalgorithmus.

atoms.text: When you have started a search, you should scroll down the page to check the results. The first website is not always the most fit for your purpose.
atoms.sound: When you have started a search, you should scroll down the page to check the results. The first website is not always the most fit for your purpose.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>purpose</voice> bedeutet Zweck oder Absicht

atoms.a: Which website is an advertisement and thus cannot be used as an objective source?
Which websites are fitting if you need objective information on artificial intelligence?
A sitelink is a link on the results page that takes you to a specific place on the website. Tap on a sitelink for each website where it is possible.

instruction.text: Welche Kriterien sollte eine Website für die Recherche erfüllen? Wähle sie aus.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>authentic</voice> bedeutet in diesem Kontext seriös

feedback.finish: The name of the author is important to understand where the information comes from.
Correct. The other website does not give the author's name, is not authentic because it includes advertisement and is thus not objective.

atoms.a: What would you do next when proceeding with your research?
b: ++Compare the given information with other sources.
++Dig into the topic and find relevant material on the websites.
Close the websites after you found out that they suit your purpose.

atoms.a: What can you do with the material?
b: ++Write it down and always remember to note down the source too.
Try to remember it for when you need it again.
++Copy and paste the information into your own document to change it into your own words later.

hint.text: to copy and paste – kopieren und einfügen
hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>to copy and paste</voice> bedeutet kopieren und einfügen
